items.description: OpenSecurityTraining.info is dedicated to sharing training material for computer security classes, on any topic, that are at least one day long.
items.title: Open Security Training

items.description: Started in 2002, funded by a total of 1.3 million dollars from NSF, and now used by hundreds of educational institutes worldwide, the SEED project's objective is to develop hands-on laboratory exercises (called SEED labs) for computer and information security education and help instructors adopt these labs in their curricula.
items.title: Hands-on Labs for Security Education

items.description: These labs cover some of the most common vulnerabilities in web applications. The labs show students how attacks work in exploiting these vulnerabilities.
items.title: Web Security Labs
